semantics.t: target hour (unix s); every UTC hour (dense=1 marks the hours inside stress windows)
semantics.src: index into hosts[] (keyed host that served the read; hosts only, never URLs)
semantics.cash: withdrawable now, token units: Aave/Spark underlying.balanceOf(aToken); MetaMorpho = the vault's PRO-RATA share of its markets' idle cash, sum over withdrawQueue of vault assets in market x market idle / market totalSupplyAssets
semantics.liquid: MetaMorpho only: the vault FIRST in line, sum over withdrawQueue of min(vault assets in market, market idle) (MetaMorpho maxWithdraw walk, no interest accrual)
semantics.flags: bit0 active, bit1 frozen (withdrawals still allowed), bit2 PAUSED (withdrawals blocked), bit3 aToken differed from head and was re-read with the historical one; MetaMorpho always 0
semantics.apr: Aave/Spark current variable borrow APR %; MetaMorpho = number of markets in the withdraw queue

aave-core-usde.study: Aave V3 USDe full 400d pinned cash grid
aave-core-usde.semantics: cash=USDe.balanceOf(aToken); debt=variableDebt.totalSupply; pinned Pool.getReserveData rates, flags and token identities; $1/USDe assumed; supply here = cash + debt (the grid did not read aToken.totalSupply)
